Earnings reports across the market for a date window, oldest first. With no parameters the window is today to 7 days ahead. Set `from` to a past date to get recent reports with actual EPS, actual revenue and surprise percentages, for example `?from=2026-09-28&to=2026-10-05`. The window can be at most 30 days.
